product_overview: Kasir Simpel is a web-based point-of-sale application for small businesses, enabling users to manage sales, stock, and store operations from a single dashboard. It supports authentication, product management, shift-based checkout, and reporting through a Nuxt and Supabase-powered interface.
core_goals: Create an account and sign in securely with email and password.
Set up a store profile before starting operations.
Manage products, categories, stock, and product images.
Process sales transactions and update inventory automatically.
Open and close cashier shifts for daily operations.
Review sales, product, transaction, expense, and shift reports.
Configure store details, payment methods, printer settings, and profile options.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can register, log in, request a password reset, and access the app after authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Enter name, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> Confirm the account from the email verification link -> Arrive at the dashboard
Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> Arrive at the dashboard
Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Enter email address -> Submit the reset request -> Receive instructions to continue password recovery
Navigate to /auth/update-password -> Enter a new password -> Submit the password update -> Return to authenticated access

features.name: Store Onboarding and Dashboard
features.description: First-time users create a store profile and then use the dashboard to review business activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Enter store name -> Select business type -> Optionally enter an address -> Save the store profile -> Continue to the dashboard
Navigate to /dashboard -> View today sales metrics -> Review recent transactions -> Review low-stock items -> Move to POS, products, reports, or settings

features.name: Shift Management
features.description: Cashiers can open a shift before selling and close it after reconciling cash.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos -> Open the cashier shift with an opening balance and operator name -> Start selling during the active shift
Navigate to /pos -> Continue working in the active shift -> Close the cashier shift with actual balance and notes -> Finish the shift
Navigate to /reports -> Review shift history

features.name: Point of Sale Checkout
features.description: Users can browse products, build a cart, complete a sale, and view the receipt while stock is updated automatically.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos -> Browse or search products -> Add products to the cart -> Set quantities and choose a payment method -> Complete the sale -> View or print the receipt
Navigate to /pos -> Add products to the cart -> Change item quantities -> Complete the sale -> See stock reduced automatically and the transaction recorded

features.name: Product and Category Management
features.description: Users can organize catalog data by creating categories and products, then updating or disabling items as needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Add a category -> Add a product with price, stock, unit, and buy price -> Save the product
Navigate to /products -> Upload a product image -> Save the image with the product
Navigate to /products -> Open an existing product -> Edit product details -> Save the changes
Navigate to /products -> Mark a product as favorite or deactivate it

features.name: Expense Tracking
features.description: Users can record expenses and include them in shift balance calculations.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Add an expense category, amount, date, and note -> Save the expense -> See the expense total update
Navigate to /reports -> Review recorded expenses -> Delete an expense entry -> See the expense list update
Navigate to /reports -> Review expense totals -> Use them in shift balance calculations

features.name: Reporting
features.description: Users can filter and review business reports for sales, products, transactions, and shifts.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Filter reports by date -> Switch between report tabs -> Review sales totals and payment breakdowns
Navigate to /reports -> Filter reports by date -> Review product-related results -> Inspect transaction details
Navigate to /reports -> Review shift history -> Print the report

features.name: Store Settings
features.description: Users can update store information, branding, payment methods, printer preferences, and their password.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Edit store profile details -> Save the store changes
Navigate to /settings -> Upload a logo -> Save the branding update
Navigate to /settings -> Configure payment methods -> Save the payment setup
Navigate to /settings -> Configure printer and Bluetooth settings -> Save the printer preferences
Navigate to /settings -> Update password -> Save the new password

features.name: Superadmin Dashboard
features.description: Superadmin users can review customer stores and subscription information from an admin view.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review customer stores -> Review revenue and transaction counts -> Inspect subscription access
Navigate to /admin -> Open a customer store record -> Edit subscription status, plan, or expiration -> Save the changes

routes.description: User registration page with email/password sign up.
Password update page after reset link.
Main store dashboard and first store setup modal.
Point-of-sale screen with shift open/close and checkout flow.
Sales, product, and shift reporting page.
Store, payment, printer, logo, and profile settings page.
Superadmin dashboard for viewing customer stores and subscription status.
Receipt display page for a completed transaction.

known_limitations.issue: TypeScript typecheck currently fails due to stale or incomplete Supabase type definitions and several component typing issues.
known_limitations.impact: Runtime can deploy, but static type safety is incomplete.

known_limitations.issue: TestSprite bootstrap timed out in current environment.
known_limitations.impact: PRD generation required manual code summary creation.

known_limitations.issue: Some schema definitions were historically created directly in Supabase and not always mirrored in repo migrations.
known_limitations.impact: Backup/restore reliability depends on keeping migrations updated.

known_limitations.issue: Local generated log files can remain locked by Nuxt dev server.
known_limitations.impact: Workspace may show ignored local artifacts until dev process exits.
